sentence: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable reasoning capabilities when prompted to generate intermediate reasoning steps (Wei et al., 2022).

sentence: Self-consistency (Wang et al., 2023) further improves reliability by sampling multiple reasoning traces and selecting the answer via majority vote.

sentence: Recent work has shown that test-time compute can be allocated more efficiently (Snell et al., 2024), motivating methods that reduce the number of full traces while preserving accuracy.

sentence: Path of Least Resistance (PoLR) (Jindal et al., 2026) addresses this efficiency challenge by exploiting prefix consistency: reasoning traces often share similar early prefixes that correlate with final answers.
